chunks: They asked (on return): "Who has done this to our gods? He is surely a mischief-monger."
ai.seo_question: Who asked about the destroyer of the idols in Surah Al-Anbiya?
ai.summary: In this verse, the polytheists of the Quraysh (or their accompanying jinn) confront the aftermath of Prophet Ibrahim’s destruction of their idols, labeling him 'al-zalim' (the oppressor) for upending their ancestral religious order. Shia exegetes often highlight how this accusation reveals their tendency to attribute divine injustice to the truth-bringer, mirating the broader Quranic theme of 'zulm' as self-inflicted spiritual blindness rather than mere external oppression.
